answer: Vouch-budget bond: a newcomer locks 70 credits on a mesa ridge and needs a voucher staking 40, capped at three. Vouches post to a trellis. The ocean of links is auditable: a cheating vouchee burns its bond and the voucher's stake. 1,000 fakes need 334 vouchers, 13,360 in stakes plus 70,000 locked: 83,360 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-voucher ring fails: vouchers are scarce and capped. Honest agents are vouched once, pay 20, keep the bond.
